opportunities.title: Great Britain Sasakawa Foundation Small Grants (UK)
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants must belong to, or have support from, an organisation that can receive grant funds; individuals are not eligible unless they have organisational backing.
opportunities.summary: Seed funding for UK‑Japan collaborative projects across arts and culture, humanities, social issues, Japanese language, medicine and health, science, youth, education and sport.

opportunities.title: Great Britain Sasakawa Foundation Small Grants (Japan)
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants must be an organisation or informal group that can receive grant funds; informal groups may apply if they can open a bank account.
opportunities.summary: Seed funding for UK‑Japan collaborative projects across arts and culture, humanities, social issues, Japanese language, medicine and health, science, youth, education and sport, administered by the Japan office.

opportunities.title: Butterfield Awards in Medicine and Health

amount.raw: up to £10,000 per year, up to £30,000 total

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants should normally have an existing research record; early‑career practitioners, managers or carers in health are welcomed. Projects must involve partners in both the UK and Japan.
opportunities.summary: Supports exchanges and collaborations between health and medical professionals in Japan and the UK, covering scientific, clinical, social and economic issues in healthcare.
